sentences.text: The Physical Fitness Division acted as a clearing house for the dissemination of information on recreation, fitness, physical education, community centres, drama, sports, the organization and administration of community and specialized programs, and related matters.
The Division provided a variety of professional consultative and informational services for the assistance of provincial government departments and national organizations.
The Division kept in touch with the latest developments abroad and circulated reports on them.

answer.text: The Physical Fitness Division acted as a clearing house for the dissemination of information on recreation, fitness, physical education, community centres, drama, sports, the organization and administration of community and specialized programs, and related matters. The Division provided a variety of professional consultative and informational services for the assistance of provincial government departments and national organizations. The Division kept in touch with the latest developments abroad and circulated reports on them.
